blocks.h2: Should You Call a Plumber Right Now?
blocks.intro: Yes, if waiting means more damage or a safety risk:

tiles.h3: Dirty Water Rising From a Drain
tiles.body: The floor drain, a basement toilet or the tub. Stop running water upstairs.
Close the main shutoff first, then call.

tiles.h3: A Sump Pit About to Overflow
tiles.body: The pump has stopped and the rain hasn't.
Close the cold water valve on top of the tank.
Get out. Call Nicor Gas or 911 from outside. We'll fix the line once it's safe.

tiles.h3: A Ceiling That's Sagging or Dripping
tiles.body: Water is collecting above it. Stay out from under it.

blocks.intro: Elgin's mix of 1800s homes near downtown and newer subdivisions on the west side means we see every kind of emergency.

items.body: The July 2017 storms dropped more than 7 inches just south of Elgin, and basements flooded across the area. Backups and failed sump pumps come in waves on nights like that. See [sewage backup service](/elgin/sewage-line-backup-services).
Older homes often have little insulation in exterior walls. In a deep freeze, kitchen and bathroom lines on those walls split first. See [burst pipe repair](/elgin/burst-pipe-repair).
When a tank fails, it can flood the basement fast. See [water heater repair](/elgin/water-heater-repair).
In an old house, the main valve may not have been turned in decades. If it won't close, we replace it.

blocks.h2: What You Get When You Call J. Blanton
blocks.intro: A plumber who fixes the problem, not a salesperson.

steps.body: We stop the damage, find the cause and give you a flat-rate price for the repair.
If the full repair can wait until morning, we'll say so.

blocks.h2: Emergency Plumbing Questions From Elgin Homeowners

items.q: How fast can a plumber get to me in Elgin?
items.preview: Call any time. We'll give you a realistic window.
items.answer: Call us any time. Our office on North McLean Boulevard keeps us close to Elgin. Arrival times depend on the day and call volume, but we'll give you a realistic window and get a plumber to you as soon as we can.

items.q: What can I do before the plumber arrives?
items.preview: Shut off the water and keep people away from sewage or electrical.
items.answer: Close the valve nearest the problem or the main shutoff. Keep everyone away from sewage and from water near outlets. If you smell gas, leave and call Nicor Gas or 911 from outside.

items.preview: Usually in the basement near the meter.
items.answer: In many Elgin homes, it's in the basement where the water line comes through the wall, near the meter. Turn it clockwise. Test it once in a while so it doesn't seize.

items.q: Is it more expensive to call at night?
items.preview: You'll get the price before any work starts.
items.answer: Whatever the hour, the plumber gives you a flat-rate price before any work begins, so you decide with the number in front of you.

items.q: How much does an emergency plumber cost in Elgin?
items.preview: It depends on the problem. You get a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on what's wrong and what it takes to fix. We give you a flat-rate price before any work begins.
